title: An unusual case of vaccine-associated paralytic poliomyelitis.
ehr_evidence: Data were derived from clinical case presentation, MRI findings, cerebrospinal fluid analysis, stool cultures, and immunization records from a public health unit and hospital.
summary: Case report describing an immunocompetent child who developed vaccine-associated paralytic poliomyelitis after receiving oral polio vaccine in China, despite prior inactivated polio vaccine doses.
key_findings: Stool culture and sequencing identified Sabin poliovirus type 3 strain with 99.7% homology to the parent OPV strain.
MRI revealed bilateral symmetric increased signal within the anterior horns of the spinal cord gray matter.
Polio antibody titres were <1:8 for type 1, 1:32 for type 2, and 1:128 for type 3.
captured_features: cerebrospinal fluid white blood cell count and protein
population: single immunocompetent child, almost one year of age
limitations: no CSF viral culture or PCR conducted initially
potential for recall bias in immunization history
